availability: Supplied narration exists. All seven mandatory scene illustrations, the airplane-wing reference, master character sheet and compatible independent character layers are currently missing. No new placeholder video is an acceptable substitute.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Hotel lobby
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: An original glamorous adult brunette arriving in an elegant hotel lobby with polished stone, restrained brass and warm lighting. Clearly show her calm face, chestnut curls and sculpted front swoop; compose portrait artwork with a believable environment and caption space below the face.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Dressing-room mirror
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: The same original brunette at a large dressing-room mirror, upright and composed. Her reflection, costume and lighting must agree; use refined vintage dressing-room details and preserve her approved face and hair silhouette.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Meeting-room entrance
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: The same original brunette entering an upscale meeting room in elegant tailored clothing. Her posture and expression convey quiet confidence. Painted room details, character outline and cel shadows must share the series art style.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Jewelry detail
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: Close-up of beautifully drawn pearl/gold jewelry and refined accessories on a dressing table, with a graceful hand if appropriate. Objects and anatomy must be complete illustrations with coherent perspective and lighting. Keep the selected accessory clear of caption space.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Executive desk
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: The same original brunette seated at an executive desk reviewing original plans and documents, with a determined but composed expression. Compose for a restrained push toward her face; no accidental generated document text.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Penthouse skyline
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: The same original brunette at a tall window in a luxurious penthouse overlooking an elegant city skyline. Include soft curtains and restrained dusk light; single flattened curtain/hair pixels cannot be claimed to move independently.

requiredSceneAssets.title: Final confident portrait
requiredSceneAssets.illustrationBrief: A satisfying confident close-up of the same original brunette with a subtle smile, expressive almond eyes, soft red lipstick, pearl earrings and the approved chestnut front swoop. Leave a clean lower-middle area for the final caption.

independentLayerRequirements.sourceOfTruth: Only configure layer paths that actually exist. None of the mandatory flattened illustrations implies a usable rig.
independentLayerRequirements.registration: All replacements are transparent, registered full-canvas rasters matched to the exact head angle.
independentLayerRequirements.mouthPolicy: Voiceover-only by default; mouth animation requires explicit matching sprites and cues.
independentLayerRequirements.actionPolicy: Footfall, walking, posture changes and putting on jewelry require authored action drawings, not deformation of a flat picture.
